annotations.title: Indicative rates for every commercial mortgage program

description: Today's indicative rate for every commercial mortgage program that has a published spread: the live index (Treasury, SOFR or prime, with its date) plus the program's spread range from a named, dated source, lowest first. Filter by property type, purpose or program family. Programs with no public spread are listed as such instead of guessed.

family.description: Program family: bank, agency, fha, life-company, cmbs, bridge, construction, non-bank, subordinate, sba, specialty.

property.description: Property type: multifamily, mixed-use, retail, office, medical-office, industrial, self-storage, manufactured-housing, hotel, senior-housing, student-housing, affordable-housing, special-purpose, land.

purpose.description: purchase, refinance (rate and term), cash-out, construction, bridge (value-add or lease-up), renovation.

name: get_rates
